"""eai-standard/2.x client (formerly rcb-limited/2.x) — the only thing a standard-mode agent gets (installed at /opt/tools/rcb_client.py).

    from rcb_client import Robot
    r = Robot()                                   # finds the service (sim:8000, then localhost:8000), waits for warm-up
    spec = r.spec()                               # action types + dims + limits, cameras, budgets
    obs = r.get_obs()                             # current frames: obs.last["head_camera"] -> uint8 HxWx3, obs.meta["proprio"]
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.05)    # actions: (T, 14); returns the execution video
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions)                    # (T, 16); planner per row (see spec)
    res.video["head_camera"]  -> mp4 bytes     res.frames["head_camera"] -> uint8 (N,H,W,3) if video="frames"/"both"
    res.last["left_camera"]   -> uint8 HxWx3   res.proprio -> float32 (N, 30)   res.meta -> dict (done, plan, clipped, ...)
    res.save("/app/runs/003")                  # meta.json, <cam>.mp4, frames/<cam>/NNN.jpg, last/<cam>.jpg, proprio.npy
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=3, video="both")   # hold the last command, let physics run 3 s, return the video

    def get_obs(self, cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"), seconds: float = 0.0,
                video_fps: int = 10, include_depth: bool = False, video: str = "frames") -> Result:
        """Current frames (seconds=0, free) or hold the last command and watch for `seconds` (returns the video)."""
        meta = {"cameras": list(cameras), "seconds": float(seconds), "video_fps": int(video_fps), "include_depth": bool(include_depth), "video": video}
        return self._post("/observe", meta, [], timeout=600)

    def status(self) -> dict:
        r = requests.get(self.base + "/status", timeout=(5, 60)); r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()

steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Vision-guided controller trajectory for Meta-World box-close-v3.
+
+This route was executed once against the supplied no-reset episode.  It uses
+only camera observations, the public target point, and TCP/mocap proprioception.
+Run with --execute only when a live episode is available; the default is a
+read-only summary so the saved record cannot accidentally move the robot.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAMS = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]
+
+
+def actions(robot, dt, rows, command, note):
+    """Submit one native ee_delta segment."""
+    a = np.tile(np.asarray(command, dtype=np.float64), (rows, 1))
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", a, dt=dt, cameras=CAMS, video="mp4", note=note
+    )
+    p = result.proprio[-1, :7]
+    print(f"{note}: tcp/mocap={np.round(p, 3).tolist()} "
+          f"steps={result.meta.get('control_steps')}")
+    return result
+
+
+def observe(robot, seconds, note):
+    """Hold still while the arm settles, then inspect the fixed cameras."""
+    result = robot.get_obs(
+        cameras=CAMS, seconds=seconds, video="mp4", include_depth=False
+    )
+    print(f"{note}: tcp={np.round(result.meta['proprio']['now'][:7], 3).tolist()} "
+          f"time_left={result.meta.get('time_left_s'):.1f}s")
+    return result
+
+
+def execute():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    dt = spec["control_dt"]
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video="mp4")
+    print("target:", obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"])
+    print("initial tcp/mocap:", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7])
+
+    # Lift clear, then use the overhead image to align with the loose lid's
+    # handle.  Camera images and the calibrated topview established x/y.
+    actions(robot, dt, 12, [0, 0, 1, -1], "lift for inspection")
+    actions(robot, dt, 18, [0, 0, 1, -1], "raise clear")
+    actions(robot, dt, 25, [1, 0, 0, -1], "move aside")
+    actions(robot, dt, 28, [-1, -0.2143, 0, -1], "align over lid")
+    actions(robot, dt, 3, [-1, -0.3333, 0, -1], "fine align")
+    observe(robot, 0.75, "settle alignment")
+    observe(robot, 0, "inspect alignment")
+    actions(robot, dt, 3, [1, 0.2, 0, -1], "center over handle")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "settle center")
+
+    # Lower in stages and test a pinch on the raised handle.  The short lifts
+    # showed that it was more reliable to guide the lid with contact and slide
+    # it toward the box than to rely on a lift-only grasp.
+    actions(robot, dt, 10, [0, 0, -1, -1], "approach height one")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "settle height one")
+    actions(robot, dt, 15, [0, 0, -1, -1], "approach height two")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "settle height two")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [0, 0, -1, -1], "lower beside handle")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "inspect grasp height")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [0, 0, 0, 1], "close around handle")
+    observe(robot, 0.25, "settle fingers")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [0, 0, 1, 1], "short lift test")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "check lift")
+
+    # Reposition lower on the handle, then make a short diagonal drag.  Keep
+    # checking all fixed views so contact direction can be corrected.
+    actions(robot, dt, 12, [0, 0, -1, -1], "reopen and lower")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "settle lower")
+    actions(robot, dt, 12, [0, 0, 0, 1], "pinch lower handle")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "settle lower pinch")
+    actions(robot, dt, 4, [0, 0, 1, 1], "short lift check")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "check lower lift")
+    actions(robot, dt, 5, [0.5, 1, 0, 1], "diagonal drag check")
+    observe(robot, 0.3, "inspect drag")
+    actions(robot, dt, 10, [0.4, 1, 0, 1], "drag toward target")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "inspect drag progress")
+    actions(robot, dt, 10, [0.52, 0.96, -0.3, 1], "guide onto box")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "inspect placement")
+    actions(robot, dt, 5, [0, 0, -1, 1], "press at target")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "inspect pressed lid")
+
+    # Move clear and use the overhead view to estimate the lid's remaining
+    # offset.  Push the near edge forward and slightly right to seat it.
+    actions(robot, dt, 16, [0, 0, 1, -1], "release and lift")
+    observe(robot, 0.35, "settle release")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [-0.96, -1, 0, -1], "return above lid")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "inspect lid")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [0.4, 1, -0.5, -1], "tip lid forward")
+    observe(robot, 0.45, "inspect tilt")
+    actions(robot, dt, 24, [0, 0, 1, -1], "lift clear")
+    actions(robot, dt, 30, [1, 0, 0, -1], "move aside for overhead view")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "inspect overhead placement")
+
+    # Approach behind the lid and make the first low push.
+    actions(robot, dt, 30, [-1, -0.6733, 0, -1], "move behind near edge")
+    observe(robot, 0.3, "settle above edge")
+    actions(robot, dt, 34, [0, 0, -1, -1], "lower behind edge")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "inspect push setup")
+    actions(robot, dt, 10, [0.5, 1, 0, -1], "diagonal edge push")
+    observe(robot, 0.45, "inspect edge push")
+    actions(robot, dt, 8, [0, 0, 1, -1], "raise to lid edge")
+    observe(robot, 0.35, "settle edge height")
+    actions(robot, dt, 5, [0, 1, 0, -1], "nudge lid forward")
+    observe(robot, 0.4, "inspect nudge")
+    actions(robot, dt, 5, [0, 1, 0, -1], "continue nudge")
+    observe(robot, 0.45, "inspect target alignment")
+
+    # Final overhead correction: return to the near side, push the lid onto
+    # the target, then lift vertically and move the hand clear.
+    actions(robot, dt, 26, [0, 0, 1, -1], "lift for final check")
+    actions(robot, dt, 22, [1, 0, 0, -1], "move aside")
+    observe(robot, 0.5, "estimate remaining offset")
+    actions(robot, dt, 26, [-1, -0.7692, 0, -1], "reposition behind lid")
+    observe(robot, 0.3, "settle final approach")
+    actions(robot, dt, 25, [0, 0, -1, -1], "lower to near edge")
+    observe(robot, 0.45, "inspect final push setup")
+    actions(robot, dt, 12, [0.3333, 1, -0.4, -1], "push lid onto target")
+    observe(robot, 0.45, "check seated lid")
+    actions(robot, dt, 25, [0, 0, 1, -1], "lift clear of lid")
+    observe(robot, 0.35, "settle clear")
+    actions(robot, dt, 20, [1, 0, 0, -1], "park hand aside")
+    final = observe(robot, 0.5, "final camera check")
+    final.save("/app/output/final_record")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(

    result = robot.submit(
        "ee_delta", a, dt=dt, cameras=CAMS, video="mp4", note=note
    )
    p = result.proprio[-1, :7]
    print(f"{note}: tcp/mocap={np.round(p, 3).tolist()} "
          f"steps={result.meta.get('control_steps')}")
    return result


def observe(robot, seconds, note):
    """Hold still while the arm settles, then inspect the fixed cameras."""
    result = robot.get_obs(
        cameras=CAMS, seconds=seconds, video="mp4", include_depth=False
    )
    print(f"{note}: tcp={np.round(result.meta['proprio']['now'][:7], 3).tolist()} "
          f"time_left={result.meta.get('time_left_s'):.1f}s")
    return result
